name: brushllm-video-studio
description: Local, free video / audio / subtitle toolbox. 100% offline.
author: BrushLLM

scripts.dist: npm run dist:mac-arm64 && npm run dist:win-x64 && npm run dist:win-arm64
scripts.dist:mac-arm64: node scripts/stage-binaries.mjs darwin-arm64 && vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config.directories.output=release/mac-arm64-build
scripts.dist:win-x64: node scripts/stage-binaries.mjs win32-x64 && vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --config.directories.output=release/win-x64-build
scripts.dist:win-arm64: node scripts/stage-binaries.mjs win32-arm64 && vite build && electron-builder --win --arm64 --config.directories.output=release/win-arm64-build
